title: MORE Thermal Gauge Theories at Finite $θ$ and $μ$ from Real-Time Quantum Simulation
summary: Imaginary-time evolution can be reconstructed from real-time quantum simulations using exact integral transforms. We identify the construction of Guo, Shibu, Lin, and Zhao as a continuous linear combination of Hamiltonian simulations and show that its slow $1/t_{\rm cut}$ convergence arises from a redundant kernel component. We extend the construction from pure-state matrix elements to thermal traces and correlators.
